name: v3_seq_scratch
hypothesis: v3 run 2 (control): same recipe as v3 run 1 (lr_sim input, K=8 unrolls, temporal 0.5, flicker hinge alpha 0.7, 35% pooled input) but from scratch (lr 3e-4, same arch, vel_scale fixed to the current model's 0.3237 so normalization matches), to test whether the v1/v2 weights carry any old-solver habit. Run 1 (fine-tune) already beats the before checkpoint on every audited metric and looks clean. Expect from scratch in 15 min to be close but slightly behind run 1 on spectrum/L1 (v2 adopted weights had ~45 min of cumulative training); adopt it only if it is equal or better and visually cleaner.
